notes.title: Open Beta Phase I is ending, and Open Beta Phase II is coming
notes.content:
Hi, thank you for joining Rune Seeker and becoming The Chosen One in the very early days of our world. Since we are in the Beta Testing Phase, we'll be updating a new patch and resetting users' data so that we can experience everything again before the official release.

🎁 LIMITED GIFT FOR THE CHOSEN ONES OF BETA TEST PHASE I 
From the time of this post, retroactively to the past, valid accounts that meet the requirements (having completed stages 1-6) will receive the Mythical Bundle: Storm Piercer.

🎁 The bundle includes:
- Storm Piercer Skin for Hero Griffin Defender
- Corresponding Arena Environment
- Corresponding Cutscene Background

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44990429/a4da10567f4c02abc31823a1de3324d75686fb92.png[/img]

The rewards will be distributed when the game officially launches.

Thank you, everyone, for participating in Beta Test Phase I. 

❌ Please note that all account data will be deleted when Beta Test Phase II begins.

You are welcome to participate in Phase II to receive additional limited rewards (🎁 TSUKIKAGE BUNDLE).

We hope to continue receiving your companionship and support on this upcoming journey.
And now, don't forget—build your legacies.

Monster Box.

./.

*Players should ensure they use the correct account information (such as email address) from the Open Beta when the game officially launches.
**Monster Box reserves the right to determine the selection of awardees, the method of awarding, and the timing of the awards.
